content.short: Blockchain at ASU promotes blockchain education and research by organizing events, workshops, and research initiatives.
content.description: Blockchain at ASU is a student-led organization affiliated with ASU's Blockchain Research Lab. It advances blockchain education and research by organizing events, workshops, and research initiatives designed to teach ASU students and the broader community about blockchain technology and its real-world applications. The group strives to foster innovation and collaboration within the blockchain ecosystem and to contribute to a more informed, capable workforce ready for future challenges.
